newsitem.title: UK: US stocks mixed in London in light dealings.
newsitem.headline: US stocks mixed in London in light dealings.

text.p: U.S. shares were mixed in London in light trading as European investors pulled away, fearing a surge in volatility ahead of key U.S. employment data on April 4, dealers said.
"The volatility has been ridiculous over the last few days and people don't want to get their fingers burnt with these figures coming up on Friday," said one dealer.
Dealers noted light selling in Chrysler Corp shares after the auto maker posted a 3.4 percent drop in March sales. The shares were off $1/4 to $30-1/8.
Shares in General Motors Corp and Ford Motor co slipped in sympathy, each losing $1/8 to $55 and $31-3/8, respectively.

Shares in Intel Corp were quoted at $139 after a federal judge on Tuesday declined the company's request for a restraining order that would have blocked Advance Micro Devices Corp's promotional materials introducing a new powerful computer chip.
Shares in Micro Devices were up $3/8 to $40.
Shares in Apple Computer Inc rose $3/8 to $17-7/8 on news that Saudi Arabia's Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud raised his stake in the firm to five percent.

Shares in Atlantic Richfield Co climbed $3/8 to $133 after the company said it would consider withdrawing from its world-wide coal business after disposing of U.S. and Australian coal mining operations, dealers said.

A negative story in the Wall Street Journal about financial shares weighed on bank shares. Citicorp eased $1/2 to $111-5/8, after a $3-7/8 jump in New York on Tuesday and J.P. Morgan and Co Inc fell $3/8 to $99-1/2.
